attributes.name: newsletter signup form style
attributes.definition: How the newsletter/email signup is presented on the page.

values.definition: A single email field placed together with a submit button.
A signup button or link with no input field shown.
No signup, or a different form pattern.

attributes.name: site search presentation
attributes.definition: Whether and how a search control is shown in the header/page.

values.definition: A visible search input field with a magnifier icon.
Search shown in another form, such as an icon-only toggle.
